title: Build manifest row
description: One row per active card in a deterministic build. Reviewed copies live in examples/**/evals/manifest.expected.jsonl; production manifests are generated outside Git.

path.description: Relative to the domain root, forward slashes.

status.description: Lifecycle status declared in the source card; stale is derived, never declared.

layer.description: Compiled answer layer, derived from the card, never hand-set.

effective_status.description: Status after applying the freshness policy at build time.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the card's UTF-8 bytes with LF line endings, including the final newline.
